b: I think there are many good reasons to not like AI, but of all the valid reasons to hate AI, this is not one of them for me.

Whenever I see debates on this online, it seems to transition into debating whether or not human learning is the same as AI training, and sure, I am not going to sit here and argue an AI training is the same as human learning, however, my issue with the consensus of "AI is intellectual theft" is that, as far as I know, human learning and AI training operate under the same principal, that it's not copying because the end result is different enough from the reference material.

I don't see how AI taking an input in a different way to humans detracts from the core principal that using references to create something new is okay. I mean, from what I've heard, Google Translate did that for years, and people didnt seem to have an issue with that, at the very least not nearly to this extent.

Some people say it literally takes images and merges them together, like photobashing, but this is misinformation. Generative AI is not photobashing. The original image is not used in the final output aside from statistical data the AI uses to calculate where it should draw pixels according to the prompt.

I hate AI, but I was never able to wrap my head around the intellectual theft argument, yet people seem to think really strongly about this. I've seen AI training off people's works cause people a lot of mental distress. It's not like I wouldn't love to share these people's concerns and go "Yes, AI training off our art is really horrible. I'm sorry things are like this.", but I just can't. I understand it on an emotional and intuition level, like, I would be lying if I said it didn't intuitively feel a bit weird at first to learn that AI is going through everything I've ever done on the internet and using it, but that's about it. It's not something that persists for me once rationale sets in.
Still though, the fact people feel so strongly about this makes me wonder if I'm just missing something, so I'd love to hear what you all think.
